name: Galen's Escape
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Please help!  These creatures are going to eat me!

Help me out of here, and I'll give you a great treasure!  It's in my camp in the swamp north of Stonard, but it's locked in a strongbox that can be opened through a trick that only I know.

If you help me escape, then I'll teach it to you.
narrative.objectives: Escort Galen out of danger, then find his camp in the Swamp of Sorrows and open his strongbox.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The keyhole of this strongbox is filled with black resin. It is impossible to open.

But Galen told you of a hidden latch on the box's bottom...

...After a quick search the latch is found. The latch is flipped, and the strongbox opens...
narrative.requestItemsText: The keyhole of this strongbox is filled with black resin.  It is impossible to open.
narrative.endText: Escort Galen out of the Fallow Sanctuary.
